caption: The drawing depicts a single, large, rounded jar with a lid, rendered in soft shades of light brown and tan. The jar has a smooth surface with a gently curving profile, widest near its middle and tapering towards a slightly narrower base and mouth. The lid is circular with a small knob handle at the top center, and it fits snugly over the mouth of the jar. The object is centrally placed against a plain, light-colored background, with a faint rectangular border sketched around the composition. There is a signature in the lower right corner that reads "Annie B. Johnston."
title: Stoneware Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
